definitions.gloss: the back of the neck; nape
definitions.explanation: the area at the back of the neck, below the hairline

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧うなじ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧うなじ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ。
examples.english: When wearing a yukata, the nape is visible and looks beautiful.

notes:
BODY PART:
うなじ refers to the back of the neck, particularly the area just below the hairline.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In traditional Japanese aesthetics, the うなじ (nape) is considered an attractive area, especially for women. The visibility of the nape when wearing ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧ or ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧ is part of their appeal. Geisha traditionally accentuate this area with makeup.

WRITING:
- Usually written in hiragana
- Can be written as {項|うなじ} but this is uncommon

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧ - neck
- ⟦{襟足|えりあし}→襟足：18005_eriashi⟧ - hairline at the back of the neck
